Vulnerability: Concatenated user input in research search SQL.
Countermeasure: Parameterized search and publication filtering; synthetic exploit comparison and regression tests pass.

Vulnerability: Record retrieval checks login but not permission on the requested record.
Countermeasure: Owner-or-staff predicates on records; default denial; cross-user tests pass. Collaborator grants are not implemented.

Threat Agent: Human error or failure - Deployment administrator
Vulnerability: Private exports or backup objects inherit public-read storage permissions.
Countermeasure: Local temporary backup only. Cloud public-access blocking and expiring download controls remain proposed.

Threat Agent: Human error or failure - Developer mistake then external attacker
Vulnerability: Live service credentials or signing secrets are committed to version control.
Countermeasure: Pre-commit rejection, Gitleaks CI and protected branches; rotate any real leaked credential. Native private-repo push protection unavailable.

Threat Agent: Espionage or trespass - Authenticated peer exploiting another query flaw
Vulnerability: Broad service role has no row policy or equivalent verified isolation.
Countermeasure: Non-owner runtime and tested application predicates; RLS not implemented.

Threat Agent: Espionage or trespass - Network observer or session thief
Vulnerability: An HTTP/session path exposes credentials or cookies.
Countermeasure: Hashed expiring bearer sessions and revocation; local HTTP only. Production HTTPS remains required. No cookie authentication.

Vulnerability: Optional attachment parser is vulnerable or execution is permitted in upload storage.
Countermeasure: No upload or attachment parsing endpoint; defer until isolated parser security is reviewed.

Threat Agent: Information extortion - Ransomware operator with credentials or DB exploit
Vulnerability: Public DB route plus exploitable authentication or overprivileged credentials.
Countermeasure: Loopback database binding, separate roles and actual synthetic restore test; immutable offsite recovery remains proposed.

Vulnerability: Search cost, request rate or body size is unbounded.
Countermeasure: Rate/body limits; staff-only solver; 5000 steps, 25000 edges, 50000 memberships, 2 MiB body; two Python workers, five-second timeout, 8 MiB output ceiling. No OS memory sandbox.

Threat Agent: Sabotage or vandalism - Malicious record contributor
Vulnerability: Untrusted research text reaches an unsafe HTML rendering sink.
Countermeasure: JSON-only API with no HTML rendering frontend; safe output rendering required for future UI.

Threat Agent: Sabotage or vandalism - Malicious authorized editor
Vulnerability: Research updates lack an attributable append-only audit record.
Countermeasure: Server-derived audit actors and runtime INSERT/SELECT-only grants; administrator can still alter history.
